Commentary.Commentary: So, the Islanders have a target of 228 to chase down. If they can get off to a good start like they did in the previous match, then this is a total they will fancy themselves against. Join us in a short while for the run chase.

Sri Lanka for the most part were good with the ball and in general, were good in the field as well. But a couple of dropped chances and some predictable field placement in the middle overs saw the Windies score some big hits. They'll be happy overall but will definitely feel they could have done so much better. Lakmal, Kulasekara and Pradeep scalped 2 wickets each while Pathirana and Gunaratne picked up 1 apiece.

Shai Hope and Jonathan Carter made an important partnership of 52 runs with the southpaw playing at a brisk rate. He ended up completing his half century. But the real damage was done towards the end as Rovman Powell came into the picture. He went on the offensive and played a real blinder. Scoring vital boundaries towards the end he ensured that his side finished with a fighting total on the board.

West Indies have ended their innings in a better position than anyone expected, especially after the way they had started things off. Although they will be slightly disappointed they didn't finish better. They lost a couple of early wickets but things were then steadied as Hope and Lewis played sensibly. They stitched a 49-run stand before the latter departed. But then Hope and Carter continued with the right-hander playing the anchor role.

OUT! SRI LANKA HAVE WRAPPED THEM UP! Lakmal once again proving to be crucial in the death. He fires in a yorker on middle and leg, Gabriel looks to dig it out but the ball goes off his pads towards short third man. Appeal for an lbw and the umpire instantly raises his finger. WEST INDIES ARE ALL OUT ON 227!
High full toss on middle and off, Nurse missed out there. He slogs hard at this but only manages to find the deep mid-wicket fielder. A single is taken.
Length ball on off, pushed back to Kulasekara.
Shannon Gabriel is the last man in for West Indies.

OUT!  He's gone! Full on middle and off, Sulieman Benn walks across to paddle it away but misses and is struck low on the pads. There are shouts for a leg before and the umpire raises his finger. Benn however decides to use the review and it goes upstairs. Replays show the ball to be crashing into off stump. So the big man has to walk back to the dressing room.
Benn has been caught leg before and given out. But he isn't too convinced and takes a review against the decision.
Fires in another fullish delivery, it's driven back down the ground.
Fuller outside off, the left-hander looks to hit it away but misses.
FOUR! Full toss outside off, Benn slaps this through point and beats Lakmal out in the deep who comes running in from third man to try and stop it with a dive.
Fuller ball on the stumps, Nurse comes down the track but ends up getting a leading edge towards covers as he closes the face a bit too early. A single is taken.
Kulasekara comes back into the attack.
Follows Benn once again as he looks to make room for himself. It's a full toss which the southpaw misses as he looks to flick it across the line.
Short of a length ball on the body, Sulieman Benn pulls it through backward square leg for a couple.
Well bowled. Seeing Benn backing away and making room, Lakmal follows him and bangs it in short, came on too quickly to Benn as he was unable to pull it away.
Full and attacking the stumps, it's driven down to long off for another run.
Another attempted yorker which misses and it's another low full toss, is is flicked through mid-wicket. One run taken.
Misses his attempted yorker and ends up bowling a low full toss on off, it's hit down to long off for a single.
Suranga Lakmal is back on to bowl.
Full ball on the stumps, it's hit hard straight to the man at mid on.
Length ball around off, it's kept out off the back foot.
Leg bye! Just back of a length on the pads, it goes off the hips on the leg side as a leg bye is taken.
Sulieman Benn walks out to bat.

OUT! HOLDER DEPARTS! He didn't wait for the umpire's decision as he knew he was gone. He works this towards short mid-wicket and sets off for a single. Kulasekara is the man there again and he is right on the money. Rushes to the ball and gets a direct hit at the bowler's end, thereby dismissing Jason Holder. He was well short of his crease.
A run out appeal against Jason Holder is referred upstairs. The Windies skipper has already started walking.
Full and aimed at the base of off stump, it's driven down towards long on for one.
Ashley Nurse is the next man in, to face the hat-trick ball.

OUT! In the air and it's taken! Pradeep takes the pace off it and bowls a slower one, on a back of a length, it's coming in on the body as Carlos Brathwaite pulls it away. He isn't able to generate enough power and it's straight into the hands of Suranga Lakmal at short fine leg who takes a good catch.
Fullish on the pads, worked to deep mid-wicket for one run and that's the end of the over.
Fullish length ball outside off, Jason Holder pushes it through the gap in the covers for a run.
On the fuller side once more, it's hit down to long on for one.
Holder is lucky Brathwaite didn't hit that hard. Full ball around off, Carlos doesn't connect well and ends up driving it to Holder. He is hit on the hand it seems but doesn't look in too much pain.
Good length delivery around off, Holder opens the face of the bat and dabs it to point for a quick single.
Can West Indies take their total around 250?
Full around off, it's driven down to long off for a single.
Jason Holder walks in next.

OUT! Powell departs but he's done his job. Full outside off, Rovman Powell looks to squeeze it out on the off side but ends up getting a faint nick on it. It's a regulation catch for Dickwella behind the stumps and that's the end of Powell's entertaining knock.
Outside off, it's run down to third man for a single.
Driven towards the mid off region. One run added to the total.

SIX! Powell is going berserk here. That's the second biggie of the over. Full on middle and leg, Powell clears his front leg and whips it hard over the mid-wicket fence. A little boy out across the ad boards catches the ball and unfortunately for the Lankans, he's not in their team. Another maximum.
Low full toss from Pradeep, it's flicked towards deep mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
SIX! Rovman Powell means business here! Banged in short on middle and off, Powell rocks onto his back foot and pulls it with all his might over the square leg fence for half a dozen.
Nuwan Pradeep comes back on.

FOUR! He's hit that with one hand. And pierced the gap as well. Unreal shot! Slower one going down leg, Brathwaite just swings his bat hard at this and removes his right hand off the bat as he does so. It pierces the gap in the square leg region as the ball goes across the fence.
Once again this full ball is whipped to deep mid-wicket and two runs are taken.

DROPPED! Should have taken that. Fuller ball on off, Powell uppishly whips it over mid-wicket. It's heading towards Shehan Jayasuriya who ends up spilling it. He did all the hard work of getting to the ball but just couldn't hold on to it. One run taken.
Yorker fired in on leg stumps, Powell just about manages to get his bat down in time and gets it off the inside edge fine down the leg side. Two runs taken.
SIX! THAT'S MUSCLED AWAY! Fuller length ball around off, Powell just stands his ground and murders the slog over the long on boundary for a maximum. What a hit! That was hit with so much power.
Full ball on the stumps, it's driven back down to long on for a single. Wanted the second but is rightly sent back by his partner in time.
Outside off, played to point for one.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
It's worked in front of square on the leg side for a run.
This fullish ball is wristed down to long on for another run.
Fuller ball on the stumps, it's eased down to long on for a single.
Coming in from around off, Brathwaite shuffles across and glances it down to long leg for a single.
Asela Gunaratne is back on.
Perfect yorker on middle, it's squeezed out back to the bowler.
Carlos Brathwaite is the next batsman in.

OUT! He was looking to up the tempo and in that attempt, has been dismissed. Fuller ball on middle and leg, Jonathan Carter picks it off his pads and flicks it aerially over square leg. He doesn't get the elevation or the distance on it and it's straight into the hands of Dhananjaya de Silva who takes it in his safe hands. A fine innings from the southpaw comes to an end.
Bowls this across around off, Jonathan Carter creams it to deep cover and some good running between the wicket allows him to come back for the second.
Very full and it's in the blockhole, Powell manages to dig it out to the left of the bowler and take a quick single.
WIDE! Very wide outside off, it goes across the wide line. Umpire signals it a wide.
Fuller in length once more, on middle and leg, it goes off the leading edge towards covers as Rovman attempts to flick it across the line.

FOUR! Great effort from Lakmal out in the deep, though. Fuller around off, it's in the slot as Powell hammers this aerially down towards long on. Suranga comes running and put in a dive forward in an attempt to take it but the ball just falls short of him. It goes off his hands and to the boundary line.
Pitched just back of a length on off, Jonathan pushes it in front of covers to end the over.
The batsman works it down the leg side. Two runs added to the total.
2nd ODI fifty for Jonathan Carter!

Back of a length delivery on the hips, Jonathan Carter hops across and tucks it towards fine leg. Runs hard and is able to come back for the second. Brings up his fifty with that and it's been a superb knock from the southpaw. He needs to make sure he stays till the end now.
It's worked through mid-wicket for a brisk single.
Short one on the stumps, Rovman Powell backs away and looks for the big pull but the ball rises on time too quickly.

Back of a length delivery on middle and leg, Powell wrists it through mid-wicket and immediately calls for the second. The batsmen run hard as the fielder from the deep fires in a throw at the striker's end. Dickwella whips the bails off but Powell makes it back in well in time.
Nuwan Pradeep is back into the attack.
Powerplay has been signalled. Which means 5 fielders will now be outside the 30-yard circle.
Low full toss on off, smashed to long on for a single to end the over.
Fullish on off, Carter drives it through mid on for a single.
Good length delivery outside off, Carter pulls out his bat at the last moment and lets it go through.
Good length ball outside off, Powell taps it to point. Yes and a no between the two batsmen and they eventually take a single.
Shortish and a slower one, pulled through square leg for a single.
Short of a length ball on off, Powell works it through square leg for a single. The umpire signals one short ball for the over.
Nuwan Kulasekara returns.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. They pick up a single.
Back of a length ball on middle, RP flicks it to mid-wicket.
Short of a length ball on off, Carter pulls it through mid-wicket for a single.
SIX! HUGE! On middle and leg, in the slot, Carter picks it early and slogs it over the mid-wicket region. The ball goes 10 rows back in the stands.
Short and outside of, Carter slaps it through covers for a couple.
Tad short outside off, Powell punches it through mid on for a single.
Landed just outside off, Carter pushes it to covers.
The batsman appears to have been struck on the thigh pad.
Short of a length ball, Powell fails to put his bat on the ball. The batsmen take a leg bye though.
FOUR! Nice shot! Full on off, Powell flicks it away through the mid-wicket region for a boundary.
Back of a length ball on off, Powell defends it off his back foot.
Landed around off, Carter tries to drive but gets an inside edge through square leg for a single.
Another off cutter outside off, Powell fails to pick this one.
Short of a length ball outside off, Powell defends it with soft hands.
Shortish on off, Carter pulls it through mid-wicket for a single.
Landed around off, Carter defends it off his back foot.
Good length ball on off, Carter tries to play but gets a bit of an inside edge onto his pads. The ball goes towards square leg for a single.
Landed outside off, Carter taps it to point and takes a quick single.
Flicked away through the square leg region for a single.
Landed just outside off, another play and a miss. Carter is struggling here.
Good length ball outside off, Carter plays it through backward point. There is a wayward throw and the batsmen take an extra run as well, two runs added to the total.
Landed around off, Carter tries to play the late cut but misses it completely.
Landed just outside off, Carter fails to put his bat on the ball.
Landed outside off, Carter covers the line and defends.
Rovman Powell walks in next.

OUT! Gunaratne gets the breakthrough! It's an off cutter outside off, Hope goes onto his back foot but the ball comes in sharply after landing, goes through and rattles the timber. Gunaratne is pretty happy out there and why wouldn't he be!
Landed outside off, Carter waits for it and guides it to third man for a single.
Shortish on off, Hope plays it down the ground for a single.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
50-run stand up between Hope and Carter!
SIX! Take that! On middle and off, Hope comes down the track and heaves it over the mid-wicket region for a biggie all the way.
Good length ball on off, angling in, Hope stays back in his crease and defends.
Drinks break!
Yet another play and a miss outside off.
Length ball outside off, Carter fails to put his bat on the ball this time.
Length ball on the pads, flicked away through square leg for a single.
FOUR! This is brilliant batting! Fuller length ball outside off, Hope reaches out at it and drives it firmly through wide mid off for a boundary.
Length ball on middle Carter flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Good shot! Full ball outside off, Carter lofts it over the mid off fielder and the ball races away to the fence.
WIDE! Way outside off, Carter goes after it but misses. The umpire signals a wide.
Landed outside off, Hope lofts it over the cover region. The fielder in the deep cuts it off. Two runs taken.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads.
Fullish ball on middle, stays low, Hope digs it out.
On the pads, Carter flicks it through backward square leg for a single.
On middle and off, Carter defends it from within his crease.
Short of a length ball on off, Carter cuts it away towards backward point.
Back of a length ball on off, Carter flicks it away to the leg side for a single.
On middle and leg, Hope flicks it stylishly over square leg for a single.
Fuller length ball outside off, driven through covers for a single.
Fullish outside off, another play and a miss as the ball stays low.
Beaten! Good length delivery around off, Carter tries to push but the ball nips away and he's beaten.
Landed just outside off, Carter pushes it towards point.
Nuwan Pradeep is back.
A bit of flight and some decent pace on that, it's kept out from within the crease.
Fuller ball coming in on middle and leg, it's worked towards mid-wicket.
Low full toss on the stumps, Jonathan drives it down to long on for a run.
Full and loopy on off, a low full toss really, it's played back in the direction of the bowler.
On the shorter side once more, the left-hander goes back and taps it down into the track.
Shorter and flatter outside off, it's punched down to long off off the back foot for a single.
Flatter and outside off, Jonathan Carter backs away and just guides it past the keeper down towards the third man region. Two runs taken.
Going down leg, dabbed straight to short fine leg with a closed face.
Flatter one on the stumps, it's worked to short mid-wicket off the back foot.
This time Shai Hope eases it down to long on after stepping out of his crease.
Great start to the over. 7 off the first 2 deliveries. It's hit down to long on for a single.

SIX! HE'S GONE DOWNTOWN! Lovely blow. Tossed up delivery outside off, Jonathan Carter waits for it to drop and smokes this straight back down the ground. Clears the fence with ease and gets a biggie to his name.
The batsman plays a pull shot to this short delivery. One run added to the total.
Outside off, it's run down to short third man.

Loud lbw shouts but it's turned down. Maybe it pitched outside leg. Length ball from Gunaratne, Carter is caught on the pads as he attempts to flick it across the line. Rightly turned down by the umpire.
Shorter and flatter around off, kept out off the back foot.

FOUR! A welcome boundary for West Indies. Short and wide outside off, Carter is onto this in a flash. He slaps it through point and sends the ball all the way for a boundary, which has come after almost 9 overs.
Jonathan Carter walks across to this one and works it to mid-wicket.
Tossed up on the stumps, Hope is forward to block.
On middle and leg, it's nudged to the square leg region for a single.
It's been driven superbly through the covers. They pick up a single.
Once more it's nudged on the leg side and a single is taken.
Works this square on the on side and gets to the other end up to complete a single.
Continues from around the wicket and tosses it up around off, Jonathan wrists it down to long on and picks up a single.
Fuller and keeps a bit low as well, Shai Hope does well and works it on the leg side from deep within the crease.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Lakmal is hit on the hands as he was backing up on that throw. Seems to be in some pain and he requires the physio to come out and treat him. Is fine to continue, though.

Straighter one on leg stump, Jonathan closes the face of the bat a bit too early and ends up gets a leading edge towards point. There is a shy at the bowler's end which misses as the batsmen run across to complete the single.
Short and wide outside off, Carter slaps this straight to the point fielder.
Some movement in the air around off, Jonathan Carter leans ahead a bit and taps it on the off side.
Length ball on off, it's worked through mid-wicket for a single.
Flights this up well, on the off pole once more, it's eased through the cover region for a single.
Around off, it's played towards the point region where the fielder makes a good diving stop.
Full around off, it's driven to the cover region for nothing.
Looped up on off, it's pushed to the off side.
Tossed up delivery which is drifting on leg, Hope is caught low on the pads as he tries flicking it across the line.
Shorter and flatter on off, Carter backs away and eases it through to deep cover for one easy run.
Length ball aiming the top of off stump, it's punched off the back foot back down to mid on. End of the over.
Angles it in on middle and leg, Shai looks to play this across the line but misses as the ball goes off his thigh pad and falls onto the track beside him.
Shorter and flatter which is coming in around off, Hope pulls it hard straight to the short mid-wicket fielder.
Full on off, Shai Hope works it to the mid-wicket region. Won't get any run for it.
Short and flat on the stumps, it's pulled through to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Going away from the left-hander, outside off, Jonathan Carter stays back and withdraws his bat to let the ball go past him.
Tossed up delivery on off, Hope presses ahead and blocks it in front of covers.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Loopy full toss on off, Carter hits it down to long on for a single. Is off the mark with that.
On the fuller side once more, Carter drives this towards the covers.
Fuller around off, it's blocked off the front foot and into the track.
Jonathan Carter walks into the middle next.

OUT! EXCELLENT BOWLING BY PATHIRANA! Seeing Lewis dance down the track Pathirana drags the length back on this one. It's outside off as Lewis looks to put bat on ball. He nicks it and Dickwella behind the stumps does well to hold on to it. The 49-run stand comes to an end with that.
Fuller ball on middle and off, Hope just pushes this back down and that's the end of the over.
Sliding down leg, looks to go aerially over square leg but misses and is hit on the pads.
Quite full and well outside off, Shai opens his body up a bit and dabs it towards backward point for no run.
Fullish in length this time and on middle and off, Shai Hope lungs forward and blocks it on the on side.
Stays back once more and plays it to the right of the bowler.
Angles it in on off stump, Hope stays back punches it towards short mid-wicket where the fielder makes a good diving stop.
Asela Gunaratne is into the attack now.
On the stumps, it's played back down the track to end the over.
On the shorter side once more, it's kept out off the back foot.
Flatter and straighter on middle and leg, Evin Lewis goes back and whips it towards mid-wicket. Some good running between the wickets allows the batsmen to come back for the second.
Short and wide outside off, Lewis rocks back and crunches it through point. Two runs are taken as the man out in the deep cuts it off.
Loopy and fullish on off, Hope leans ahead and drives it through the covers for one.
From around the wicket, Pathirana floats it up and it's drifting in on middle, Hope gets an inside edge onto his pads as he tries to drive it away.
The batsman works it down the leg side. One run added to the total.
Driven through mid off for a single.
Shortish around off, Lewis tries to play but fails to put his bat on the ball.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman to long on. One run added to the total.
Flighted outside off Hope blocks it out solidly.
Flatter around off, Hope defends it off his front foot.
Shortish on off, Hope punches it through the right of the bowler for a single.
Fullish on middle, Hope defends it into the ground.
On middle and leg, Lewis flicks it to long leg for a single.
On middle and off, flicked away towards mid-wicket.
Shortish on middle and off, Lewis punches it away off his back foot.
Tad short on off, Lewis punches it to covers.
Sachith Pathirana is brought into the bowling attack.
FOUR! Great shot! Full outside off, Hope get on top of it and drives it firmly through the cover region for a boundary to end the over.
Tad short on off, Hope looks to punch it towards mid on but the bowler goes to his right and puts in a dive to stop the ball.
Lewis sweeps it through the square leg region for a single.
Full outside off, Lewis drives it through the cover region. The fielder does a great job and stops the ball. Two runs taken.
Full on off, Hope drives it through mid on for a run.
Tossed up ball outside off, Hope punches it away off his back foot.
On middle and off, Lewis pushes it to mid on off his back foot.
Shortish around off, Lewis cuts it towards point but there is a fielder.
Banged in short on middle and off, Lewis ducks under it.
Short of a length ball around off, Hope guides it to third man for a single.
Fuller length ball on off, Hope drives it to mid on.
Shortish outside off, Lewis punches it through covers for a single.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball. One run added to the total.
On middle and leg, Hope comes forward and smacks it towards wide long on. The batsmen take a single as he didn't time it that well else it would have been a boundary.
Shortish outside off, Lewis rocks back and cuts it through cover-point for a single.
On middle, Hope goes onto his back foot and punches it to long on for a single.
Tossed up outside off, Hope drives it towards mid off.
Landed outside off, Lewis pushes it towards extra cover for a single.
Landed outside off, pushed towards covers once again.
Full outside off, Hope drives it to the cover region.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot. They pick up a single.
Good length ball outsie off, Lewis leaves it alone.
Fuller length ball outside off, Hope drives it through mid off and takes a quick single.
Landed just outside off, Lewis guides it to third man for a single.
WIDE! Down the leg side, Lewis tries to clip but misses.
Nuwan Pradeep is back.
Drinks break!
The batsman has played it towards mid-wicket.
Full on middle and off, Hope flicks it to mid-wicket.
The stump broke! Well, as that direct hit was scored on the previous delivery, the off pole is now in two pieces. A replacement is being brought in the middle.
Landed outside off, Hope plays it towards point and looks for a run but he's sent back. There is a direct hit at the striker's end and the stump is broken there.
Shortish outside off, punched through covers for a single.
Fuller on off, Hope taps it to the off side for a single.
Full ball on off, driven through point for a single.
Shehan Jayasuriya comes on to bowl.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Fullish around off, Hope drives it towards mid off.
Fuller length ball around off, Hope drives it towards mid off.
Landed around off, Shai pushes it to the off side off his back foot.
Back of a length ball on off, Hope punches it to mid on.
Short and wide outside off, Lewis slaps it through covers for a single.
Short of a length ball on off, Hope does well to defend this one.
Landed around off, Shai defends it off his back foot this time.
That ball has taken the inside edge of the batsman and thudded into his pads.
Good length ball on off, Hope stays back in his crease and defends.
In the corridor outside off, Hope allows it through.
FOUR! EDGED! Landed outside off, some width on offer, Hope is tempted and goes after it but gets a thick outside edge towards third man for a boundary.
Fuller length ball on off, Lewis drives it to mid off.
FOUR! Crunched! Back of a length ball on off, Lewis punches it through covers by lifting his right leg a bit. Gets a boundary.

DROPPED! Oh dear, Dickwella has dropped a sitter! Nicely bowled, good length ball on off, good carry, Lewis tries to push but gets an outside edge. The ball flies to the left of the keeper who fails to grab an easy catch.
Length ball on middle and off, Lewis pushes it towards mid on.
On middle and off, Hope works it through backward square leg for a single.
Good length ball outside off, Hope defends it off his back foot.
Nuwan Kulasekara is back into the attack.
Length ball on middle, worked away through mid-wicket for a single.
Angles it on the pads, Hope works it to fine leg for a couple.
Good length ball outside off, Hope pushes it towards cover-point.
FOUR! Now that's a glorious shot! On middle and off, Hope uses his wrists and tucks it through the gap between mid on and mid-wicket for a boundary to get off the mark in ODIs.
Play and a miss! That's a beautiful delivery! Good length ball outside off, Hope tries to play it off his back foot but fails to put his bat on the ball.
Landed just outside off, Hope covers the line and defends.
Powerplay 2 time. Four fielders are allowed outside the 30-yard circle.
It's around the off stump, it's pushed towards the cover region and that will be the end of the over.
Shai Hope walks in at No.4.

OUT! BRATHWAITE IS GONE! How unfortunate for him, though. So, so unfortunate. He works this length ball towards Kulasekara at mid on and takes him on. He scurries to the other end and slides his bat as Nuwan gets a direct hit at the bowler's end. The decision goes upstairs and replays show that Brathwaite's bat just got jammed right before the line. He is frustrated but he is going to have to make the long walk back. Good work by Kulasekara nonetheless as his effort has got the wicket.
A run out appeal against Kraigg Brathwaite is referred upstairs by the umpire.
Pretty straight on middle and off, KB punches it back out towards mid on.
Attacks that off pole once more and pitches it marginally ahead of a length, Kraigg Brathwaite with a closed face works it on the on side.
Lakmal once more keeps it really tight, keeps it very close to the off stump, Brathwaite closes the face of the bat and turns it in front of the mid-wicket region.
Length delivery outside off, Brathwaite stays behind the line and keeps it out rather comfortably.
Stays deep within his crease and keeps it out off the back foot.

Seems height was an issue there. Looked close, though. Back of a length seaming in on middle and leg, Evin Lewis goes across to flick it across the line but misses and is caught on the pads. Shouts for a leg before by the Lankans but it's turned down.
Back of a length ball outside off, there's some extra bounce off the deck as well, arms are shouldered to this one.
Shaping in on middle and leg, Lewis picks it off his pads and works it in front of mid-wicket.
Short of a length delivery outside off, it's not bothered with by the batsman.

Instant swing for Pradeep. He bowls a length delivery around off to start things off and gets it to swing in to Evin Lewis, the southpaw stands firm and punches it square on the off side towards point.
Nuwan Pradeep comes into the bowling attack.
Similar ball and a similar defensive shot by Kraigg Brathwaite which brings us to the end of the over.
Fuller in length outside off, defended off the front foot and into the track.
Great use of the wrists there. Back of a length on middle, Brathwaite tucks it through backward square leg and a couple of runs are taken as the fielder from fine leg comes across to cut it off.
Length ball just outside off, Kraigg Brathwaite gets an inside edge onto his thigh pad as he tries to have a tame poke at it. It rolls just wide of the slip fielder but no run is taken.
Fractionally ahead of a length and Lakmal hits the deck hard here, Brathwaite once again meets it with a straight bat as he taps it to the left of the bowler.
Fullish in length and speared in outside off, Kraigg punches it in front of the cover region. Dot ball.
Seems height's an issue there. The southpaw is rapped on the thigh pad as he looks to play at that. Maybe a bit of an inside edge was there as well.
Kulasekara fires in an extremely full ball, almost a yorker, Evin Lewis does well to bring his bat down in time and squeezes it back down the ground. Well bowled and equally well played.
Length delivery outside off, blocked off the front foot to the off side.
Keeps this on a length on the stumps, Evin Lewis camps back and plays it back in the direction of the bowler.
Fine leg is in the circle and a deep square leg is in place now.
A bit fuller in length this time, outside off, Brathwaite opens the face of the bat and runs it down to third man for a single.
Seaming in on middle and leg, the left-hander does well to keep it out.
Length ball outside off, it's left alone to end the over.
On middle and leg, Brathwaite hops across and tucks it down to long leg for an easy single.
Short of a length delivery outside off, Lewis hangs back and punches it through cover-point. The timing wasn't all that great but he still manages to get a single.
Another back of a length ball outside off, it's punched off the back foot to covers.
Back of a length delivery around off, Evin Lewis gets a bottom edge onto the track ahead as he looks to punch it on the off side.
Too straight from Lakmal, it's on middle and leg, Lewis defends it on the leg side.

Just short off the deck a bit there. Length ball outside off, Brathwaite just removes his bottom hand as he defends this on the off side. It was rising a little but Kraigg did well not to get an edge of any sort on that.
Length ball angling in on middle and leg, worked gently on the on side. Won't get any run for it, though.
WIDE! Going down leg once more, another wide.
Stays perfectly behind the line of this length delivery and taps it down into the track with a straight blade.
Length ball well outside off, KB makes a good leave.
WIDE! Bowls this down the leg side again, Kraigg looks to flick it away but misses as it's collected by the keeper behind. Wide called by the umpire.
FOUR LEG BYES! Sprays this on the hips, Brathwaite looks to tuck it down fine but it goes off his thigh pad. It beats the diving keeper and rolls away to the boundary line behind.

FOUR! Beautiful shot. Fuller length delivery well outside off, Brathwaite takes a big stride across and just punches it through extra cover. Was all about the timing that shot as the ball raced away to the fence.
Back of a length delivery around off, Evin Lewis stands tall and punches it through the gap in the covers. Will get a brace for it.
Very wide outside off, Lewis leaves it alone. Could have been a wide if it was an inch more to the right. Close one.
Coming in on middle and leg, pitched slightly ahead of a length, Lewis clips it through the square leg region for a couple of runs.
Length ball seaming away outside off, Lewis stays back and cuts it hard straight to the man at point who makes a tumbling stop.
Quick alert running this. Brathwaite taps this in front of mid-wicket and immediately calls for the single. His partner responds and the batsmen complete the run. Nicely done.
Evin Lewis is the next man in.

OUT! LAKMAL WITH THE EARLY BREAKTHROUGH! Charles with a poor, poor shot. Don't know what he's doing there. Length ball around off, Johnson Charles just looks to slog it hard across the line. He gets a big, big top edge which flies towards third man. Kusal Perera is the man there and he does a fantastic job. Runs to his left, sets himself under the ball and takes a fantastic catch. What makes the catch even better is that the sun was in his eyes and the ball was moving a bit. Terrific take!
At 123 kph, a length ball well outside off again, KB stands firm and blocks it down into the track to end the over.
Shaping away after hitting the deck, outside the off stump, no shot is offered to that one.
Length delivery in the channel outside off, taps it in front of covers.
This one is on the stumps and worked towards the mid-wicket region for no run.
Once again it's on a length, outside off, Kraigg Brathwaite walks across to this one and with an open face, taps it square on the off side.
On a good length and outside off, left alone for the keeper to collect.

Lovely timing. Length ball outside off, Brathwaite just punches this through the cover region. The fielder chases it down as the batsmen run hard for the third one. They take the throw on and beat it rather easily.
Short of a length once more, Kraigg rises and keeps it down comfortably.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Brathwaite stands his ground and defends it off his back foot.

Back of a length delivery just around off, Kraigg Brathwaite shuffles across a touch and works it through backward square leg for a couple of runs. Was in the gap and hence, the second one was easily taken.
Coming in on the hips, Charles glances it down to fine leg for a single.
Length delivery on middle stump, Lakmal with a straight one, it's kept out from within the crease in front of mid-wicket.
Suranga Lakmal will bowl from the other end.
Very slight hint of away swing here, but it's quite harmless as it's well outside off, Kraigg leans forward and shoulders his arms to that.
Slightly fuller in length on middle and off, it's worked towards the mid-wicket region for a single. Gets off the mark with that.
Pitched just back of a length, around off, it's defended from deep within the crease.
Tighter line as it's quite close to the off stump, same length, Johnson Charles stays back and keeps it out off the back foot.
On a good length once more and it's outside off, Charles yet again is watchful as he leaves it alone.
Starts off with a good length delivery outside off, Charles doesn't have anything to do with that one as he lets it go through.

We are all set to get underway as the players and the umpires have made their way out in the middle. It will be Johnson Charles and Kraigg Brathwaite to open the innings for West Indies with Nuwan Kulasekara taking the ball first up for Sri Lanka.

JASON HOLDER says the preparation is good as they had a few days to prepare prior to this match. Informs there are a few changes, Hope and Nurse will make their ODI debuts while Powell will be making his international debut. Stresses that they are expecting big things from them. Is wary and says they have to watch out for the first hour but then it will get easier to play.
UPUL THARANGA says they will bowl first. Mentions that it's a very good pitch and it won't change much so batting will be easier. States they have the same team.
SRI LANKA WIN THE TOSS AND HAVE OPTED TO BOWL FIRST!

Pitch Report - A bit of cloud cover despite the sunshine. So there might be a bit of rain later. It's a bit dry but it will be fair for both teams. Little bit of green. Rock hard, with a tinge of green grass. Will be good to win the toss and put on a big score here, reckons Pat Symcox.

There is a thunderstorm predicted for today. It's said to be looming around in the area but it doesn't seem that threatening. Hopefully and most likely, we don't have any interruptions because of that. Let's keep our fingers crossed so that we can have a full day's cricketing action.

Looking into the West Indies' squad, they don't have many notable faces this time around. With Darren Bravo sent back home and Marlon Samuels being over looked, the team only has about 5 players with some kind of experience. They do have some exciting players but the onus will be on those experienced players to really step up and guide their teammates through this tournament. Should be an interesting contest.

Hello and a warm welcome for the second encounter of this Tri-Nation series. After beating the home side in the opener, the Lankans will now go up against the Windies at Harare Sports Club once more. Despite running through Graeme Cremer and his men rather comfortably, the Islanders won't look much into that victory but at the same time, will want to keep the momentum going. They have a solid team but one will wonder if Lakshan Sandakan or Dasun Shanaka might get a look in.
